name: portfolio-rag
description: Cloudflare Worker backing the 'Ask about my work' widget on ajaykumarbalakannan.com

scripts.logs: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT asked_at, session, turn, question, answer, country FROM turns ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 40" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
scripts.logs:today: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT asked_at, session, turn, question, answer, country FROM turns WHERE date(asked_at) = date('now') ORDER BY id DESC" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
scripts.logs:count: wrangler d1 execute portfolio-chat-logs --remote --json --command "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_turns, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS conversations, MAX(asked_at) AS latest FROM turns" | python3 ../scripts/format_chats.py
